name: Furrbit at the campfire
notes: Furrbit on the intro screen. It only shows once it is unlocked (unlocked >= 1) and sits on the half circle behind the fire: its seat depends on how many monsters are unlocked, all of them spread evenly from left to right in roster order, so with 1 unlocked it takes seat 1. It always looks at the fire (view per number unlocked: 1: down, 2: down-right, 3: down-right, 4: side, 5: side, 6: side, 7: side, 8: side, 9: side). When it is shiny it shimmers through the rainbow, like everywhere else.
